query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pipelineStage IN ('quote_sent','Quote Sent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as quotes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pipelineStage IN ('Proof Sent','proof_sent') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as proofs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pipelineStage IN ('Approved + Deposit') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deposits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pipelineStage IN ('In Production') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as production,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pipelineStage IN ('delivered') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as delivered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pipelineStage IN ('Lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lost,
  SUM(humanTakeover) as human_takeover_total
FROM leads;
